title: Make WhatsApp contact links cleaner and simpler

requirements.text: Update the WhatsApp link generation so the default WhatsApp CTA uses a clean, minimal URL (no prefilled message query string), while still supporting an optional prefilled message when explicitly requested.

quotes: Bhai link clean bnao na easy wala

acceptanceCriteria: When no message is provided, WhatsApp links resolve to the clean format `https://wa.me/<number>` with no `?text=` query string.
When a message is explicitly provided (e.g., property-specific inquiry), the link includes a `?text=` query string with proper URL encoding.
All WhatsApp links continue to use the centralized `CONTACT_CONFIG.whatsappPhone` number.

requirements.text: Update all WhatsApp CTA entry points (including the floating WhatsApp button and any card-level WhatsApp actions that use the default message) to use the new clean default WhatsApp link behavior.

quotes: Bhai link clean bnao na easy wala

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the floating WhatsApp button opens WhatsApp using the clean `wa.me/<number>` link (no prefilled message).
Any CTA that previously called `generateWhatsAppLink()` with no arguments now opens WhatsApp using the clean link.
Property/project-specific CTAs that intentionally include context may still open with a prefilled message (short and readable), using the message-enabled link generation path.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only Shadcn components).
Keep changes within the existing React + TypeScript + Tailwind structure; no external link shortener services.
nonGoals: Adding third-party link shorteners (e.g., Bitly) or any external integrations.
Changing the site’s contact phone number configuration (only link cleanliness is in scope here).
